scenes.headline: How a video model learns to look ahead
scenes.sub: Future Chunk Prediction: one extra loss, dropped at inference.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Thole! This video model writes a clip chunk by chunk. One extra training loss teaches it what happens next.

scenes.text: From the current chunk's features alone, side predictors must generate chunks further ahead, without the chunks in between and without the prompt.
scenes.say: The idea: from the current chunk alone, side predictors must draw chunks further ahead, with the gap hidden and no prompt.

scenes.title: Why the usual training is too easy

left.title: Teacher forcing
items: Clean history, denoise the next chunk
Neighbouring chunks look almost the same
Continuing the past is a shortcut
left.say: Usually the model sees the real history and denoises the next chunk. Neighbouring chunks look alike, so continuing the past almost works.

right.title: Add future chunks
items: The chunks in between are withheld
right.say: Ask for a chunk further out, with the gap hidden, and continuity stops helping.

steps.say: The generator reads the clean history and the current chunk, and builds its hidden states.
Those feed side predictors, one per offset, each with its own weights and no prompt.
Each predictor denoises a chunk further ahead, and its loss flows back into the generator.
At inference, every predictor is deleted. The generator runs exactly as before.

left.title: Chained predictors
items: Each head reads the previous head
Which saw a noisy in-between chunk
left.say: Chain the heads, and each inherits a noisy copy of the chunk it should not see.

right.title: Parallel predictors
items: Every head reads the current chunk only
No path from the chunks in between
The features must carry the future
right.say: In parallel, the only route to the future runs through the current chunk's features.

steps.say: Sampled from the current chunk alone, the next-chunk predictor tracks the real wave closely.
Three chunks out, detail goes, but the curl and break remain.

scenes.title: Physics-IQ Verified, 5B image to video
scenes.note: mean of four seeds, matched data and steps
scenes.say: On the five billion model, the score rises from thirty point four to thirty-three point eight. Chained heads reach only thirty-one.

scenes.label: side-predictor parameters on the 5B model, training only
scenes.note: counted from the code, matched to checkpoint sizes
scenes.say: They are not small: about three and a half billion extra parameters, though only during training.

scenes.text: Make the current chunk's features predict a later chunk, with the gap hidden, and the gains show up in when things move.

recap: Predict later chunks from the current one
Parallel heads, no prompt, gap hidden
scenes.say: To recap: predict ahead from the current chunk, keep the heads parallel, and drop them before inference.
